text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Reoccurrence of law violations in Beirut elections.
-Indifference among West Beirut voters and boycotting by east Beirut voters.
-Preliminary results: Prime Minister Hariri first then former prime minister Hoss followed by MP Wakim.
-Lebanon refuses Israel's complaint to the five-nation committee, monitoring the April ceasefire understanding.
-Parliament Speaker Berri: Hizbollah refused to be our ally in the south Lebanon elections.
-Hizbollah to announce its list in the Bekaa valley.
-Hariri: Beirut elections will determine our future.
-Maronite Patriarch Sfeir Nasrallah: Democracy is hollow in Lebanon.
-Supporters of exiled former army commander General Aoun demonstrated in east beirut.
